capabilities: Color file explorer items by their first alphabetical character
Stamp navigation items with data-alpha-char attributes via regex matching
Apply muted resting color states to folders and markdown files
Watch explorer changes with a MutationObserver and debounced layout hooks
disambiguation: Not about alpha-channel colors or pre-release software; 'alpha' refers to the first letter of each file or folder name.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README is written largely for AI developers and points to an AGENTS.md-based documentation set rather than end-user instructions.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer renders all items in a uniform style, making it hard to visually tell entries apart at a glance.
summary: File explorer styling plugin that colors folders and files by their first alphabetical character across an HSL hue spectrum.
